summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's listing requirements after filing its overdue annual report. No special situation transaction is involved; the filing only reports compliance with listing rule 5250(c)(1) and a cancelled hearing. Under SEC rules, Form 6-K is used for current reports by foreign issuers, and this content is purely procedural.
